autoSaveLabel: Every change here is saved automatically
appNotOperational: The app linked to this tool is currently disabled.
appDisabledError: The app linked to this tool is currently disabled.
descProductConversion: Urgency, trust, and completion tools within the purchase decision itself.
descOffersBundles: Tools to increase average order value through recommendations and quantity offers.
descGrowthWidgets: General tools that work at the store or session level, not just inside the buy box.
descSellingModes: Special selling methods for products that need a different scenario than standard purchase.
descReviewsSocialProof: Visual content and social proof tools within reviews.
expectedLookCaption: This is how the tool will look once you enable it — enable it from the settings beside.
previewMockCaption: Approximate preview — the final look on your store follows your store theme.
generalEnabledNote: Enabling this tool also turns on the whole {{app}} app.
toolsIndexDesc: Every tool gets its own page: understand the benefit, see it live on your store, and enable it when ready. Every change saves automatically.

saleCountdown.label: Sale Countdown Timer
saleCountdown.benefit: Runs a countdown timer on the product page during limited-time offers.

lowStockNotice.label: Low Stock Notice
lowStockNotice.benefit: Shows a low-stock alert for size or color before adding to cart.

soldCounter.label: Sold Counter
soldCounter.benefit: Displays current purchase pace above the buy section.

purchaseFomo.label: Purchase Count & FOMO
purchaseFomo.benefit: Shows current purchase pressure from carts or recent activity.

estimatedDelivery.label: Estimated Delivery
estimatedDelivery.benefit: Shows the estimated delivery window on the product page.

trustedBadges.label: Trusted Badge
trustedBadges.benefit: Displays payment, delivery, and return badges near the buy button.

stickyAddToCart.label: Sticky Add to Cart bar
stickyAddToCart.benefit: Keeps the add-to-cart button visible while scrolling on the product page.

backInStock.label: Back in Stock
backInStock.benefit: Enables back-in-stock interest collection for unavailable sizes or colors.

crossSell.label: Cross Sell
crossSell.benefit: Runs cross-sell product suggestions in dedicated spaces.

boughtTogether.label: Bought Together
boughtTogether.benefit: Shows product bundles frequently bought together on the same page.

bulkSavings.label: Bulk Savings
bulkSavings.benefit: Runs quantity savings directly on the product page.

buyMoreSaveMore.label: Buy More Save More
buyMoreSaveMore.benefit: Runs full quantity-break panels and mix-and-match options on the page.

freeShippingBar.label: Free Shipping Bar
freeShippingBar.benefit: Shows a free-shipping bar storewide, in cart, and checkout when enabled.

inactiveTab.label: Inactive Tab
inactiveTab.benefit: Changes the tab title when the user navigates away from the page.

exitIntentPopup.label: Exit Intent Popup
exitIntentPopup.benefit: Runs an exit-intent popup when the user tries to leave the store.

fakeVisitorCounter.label: Fake Visitor
fakeVisitorCounter.benefit: Runs a real-time visitor counter as part of behavioral signals.

fakeSalePopup.label: Fake Sale Popup
fakeSalePopup.benefit: Runs a live purchase-activity popup at the store level.

preOrder.label: Pre Order
preOrder.benefit: Allows selling products before they are physically in stock.

externalAffiliate.label: External / Affiliate Product
externalAffiliate.benefit: Redirects the purchase flow to an external platform or link.

photoReviews.label: Photo Review
photoReviews.benefit: Allows customers to attach photos in their reviews.

videoReviews.label: Video Review
videoReviews.benefit: Allows attaching videos in reviews when writing feedback.

verifiedBadge.label: Verified Badge
verifiedBadge.benefit: Displays a verified-purchaser badge within reviews.

productWishlist.label: Product Wishlist
productWishlist.benefit: Heart button that lets customers save favorite products to buy later.

productComparison.label: Product Comparison
productComparison.benefit: Comparison button that lets customers compare features and specs easily.

freeShippingAmount.label: Free Shipping Threshold
freeShippingAmount.description: The amount the customer needs to reach for free shipping to apply.

previewRealThemeCaption: Approximate preview using your current store theme — the final look follows your theme settings.
